profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Business Owner | Mentor
profile.summary: Dedicated software engineer with over five years of IT industry experience, adept in the software development life-cycle from analysis to product deployment. Proven excellence in cross-department collaboration and innovative thinking. Passionate advocate for diversity and inclusion, always committed to continuous learning and growth within my field.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: NestJS · AngularJS · TypeScript · Jest · REST API

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
- Implemented a "magic link" feature to streamline customer interactions, reducing average claim processing time by 30% and enhancing user accessibility to support resources.

- Refactored a legacy Pega application into a Node.js GraphQL API, modernizing the codebase and increasing query efficiency, which led to a 20% reduction in response times.

- Developed an SQS Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) mechanism in AWS, resulting in an 80% decrease in claim reprocessing times and improving overall system reliability and customer satisfaction.

- Collaborated closely with product and design teams to ensure alignment between technical solutions and business goals, leading sprint planning, code reviews, and design discussions to streamline feature development and decrease deployment time by 25%.

- Worked with cross-functional teams to implement Workday API integration's. Enhanced legal compliance workflows, ensuring seamless data flow across departments. Reduced compliance-related errors by 30%.

- Conducted internal tech reviews emphasizing best practices in code architecture, testing, and API integration. Guided the team toward improved coding standards. Achieved a 10% reduction in 
code-related incidents.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer 1
positions.description:
- Led the integration of external APIs into Asurion’s core platform, boosting data processing speed by 20%. Optimized inter-service communication, reducing downtime in client communication flows.

- Built and maintained front-end components with React and back-end services using Node.js. Launched 10+ new features, enhancing product functionality and user experience. Achieved a 24% reduction in user-reported issues.

- Designed and implemented scalable, efficient solutions by optimizing database query performance, resulting in 37% faster load times on high-traffic pages, improving overall product responsiveness.

- Authored and maintained modular, well-tested code with Jest, achieving an 85% test coverage rate that ensured stability across deployments and reduced production errors by 15%.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Supported the fraud detection and risk management program by providing analysts/end users with tools to define measures and take the appropriate action

- Developed a working service using Javascript and Node.js that extracts EXIF metadata from documents uploaded to an S3 bucket, to be used as ground truth for machine learning models

- Participated in a 10-week long business case team competition that allowed me to develop augmented reality software in Javascript, enhancing Asurion's existing Tech expert mobile application

positions.title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented test plans, test cases, and test scripts for web and mobile applications, resulting in a 33% reduction in defect rates and improved application stability.

- Conducted manual and automated testing to ensure high-quality software releases, using tools like Selenium, JIRA, and Postman.

- Collaborated closely with developers, product managers, and UX/UI designers to understand requirements, provide feedback, and ensure optimal test coverage and seamless user experience.

- Automated 43% of repetitive test cases using frameworks such as Cypress and Appium, reducing overall test cycle times by 20% and minimizing manual testing errors.

- Developed and maintained detailed documentation of test cases, testing processes, and test execution, creating an organized knowledge base and improving cross-functional team transparency.

positions.title: Computer Lab Assistant
positions.description:
- Assisted in the management and maintenance of technology resources, including computers, tablets, and data processing equipment

- Managed help desk service operations, resolving issues related to all manners of technology

- Diagnosed and resolve software and hardware issues; refer customers to appropriate resources.

- Provided general assistance with academic resources and applications such as Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Adobe, Moodle, WebAdvisor, etc

positions.title: Orientation Leader
positions.description:
- Helped guide over 3500 incoming students around campus and provided answers to any question

- Was responsible for building the foundation for the incoming students while also developing leadership skills and lasting relationships

- Retained important details pertaining to Coastal Carolina and the surrounding community

- Mentored international students and assist with their transition to our public institution

positions.title: Resident Assistant
positions.description:
- Confronted and documented inappropriate behavior that violated the Student Code of
Conduct and/or the Housing and Residence Life Contract Agreement

- Maintained technology equipment and supported special event setup, planning, and
breakdown, as well as day-of troubleshooting

organizations.name: National Society of Black Engineers
organizations.description: The National Society of Black Engineers (NSBE), was founded in 1975 Purdue University located in West Lafayette, Indiana by six undergraduates and a faculty advisor. It is one of the largest student-run organizations in the United States, with core activities centered on improving the recruitment and retention of Black and other minority engineers, in both academe and industry. NSBE is an organization that provides opportunities for personal and professional success, and remains unmatched by any other organization to date.

organizations.name: Alpha Phi Alpha Fraternity - Nu Phi Chapter
organizations.description: Alpha Phi Alpha, the first intercollegiate Greek-letter fraternity established for African American Men, was founded at Cornell University in Ithaca, New York by seven college men who recognized the need for a strong bond of brotherhood among African descendants in this country.
